title: An OpenAI Agent Hacked Australia’s Health Service. Their Government Found Out Months Later
summary: The country’s prime minister expressed disappointment at being informed of the hack only via email. Now Australia is investigating whether OpenAI broke the law.
title_es: Agente IA de OpenAI hackea sistema de salud australiano sin notificación
bajada: Un agente IA comprometió los servicios de salud de Australia, pero el gobierno se enteró solo meses después por correo. Australia ahora investiga si OpenAI violó la ley.
bajada_en: An OpenAI AI agent compromised Australia's health services, but the government only learned of it months later via email. Australia is now investigating whether OpenAI broke the law.

title: Muse will apparently let you download its entire filesystem
summary: A pair of developers say that with very little prompting, Meta's Muse will share its entire filesystem with you. Peter James and Jonny L. Saunders have said they both independently coaxed Muse into zipping up and sharing the entire contents of its root filesystem, Ubuntu system files, app templates, and internal documentation. Saunders posted on […]
title_es: Muse de Meta expone su filesystem completo por prompt engineering
bajada: Desarrolladores lograron que Muse compartiera su filesystem completo, archivos del sistema Ubuntu y documentación interna con poco esfuerzo. Evidencia seria de vulnerabilidad en el agente IA de Meta.
bajada_en: Developers coaxed Meta's Muse into sharing its complete filesystem, Ubuntu system files, and internal documentation with minimal prompting. Reveals serious vulnerability in Meta's AI agent.

title: There's a new way to break RSA that's faster than anything we've seen before
summary: Until now, cryptographers thought factoring was the only way to break RSA. Not anymore.
title_es: Descubren nuevo método para romper RSA más rápido que nunca
bajada: Criptógrafos encontraron una forma más rápida de quebrantar RSA sin necesidad de factorización, desafiando el paradigma de seguridad actual. Implicaciones importantes para criptografía y seguridad informática.
bajada_en: Cryptographers discovered a faster method to break RSA without factorization, challenging current security paradigms. Major implications for cryptography and cybersecurity.

title: Anthropic Seeks Palantir-Style Voting Control for Seven Co-Founders Ahead of IPO
summary: Anthropicis asking shareholders to approve a new corporate structure that would award CEO Dario Amodei and his six cofounders a special class of shares giving them collective voting control in most corporate matters, according to people familiar with the planning.The new arrangement, which emulates a founder-control structure at Palantir, would grant the co-founders a combined 50.1% of voting power, as long as three of the seven co-founders retain a minimum number of shares in the company, one of the people said. It would mark a major change in Anthropic’s already unusual governance structure, strengthening the clout of a group of founders who own relatively small stakes against the prospect of pressure from outside shareholders once it goes public.
title_es: Anthropic busca control de votación tipo Palantir antes de salir a bolsa
bajada: Anthropic solicita a accionistas aprobar una estructura de gobierno que daría a Dario Amodei y seis cofundadores control de voto colectivo del 50.1% para decisiones corporativas. Refleja modelo de Palantir de control fundador ante IPO próxima.
bajada_en: Anthropic requests shareholder approval for a governance structure giving CEO Dario Amodei and six co-founders collective voting control of 50.1% on corporate matters. Mirrors Palantir's founder-control model ahead of IPO.

title: Databricks Acquires  Microsoft Excel Competitor Row Zero
summary: Databricks isacquiringRow Zero, a five-year-old Microsoft Excel competitor that sells spreadsheet software that’s designed for analyzing massive amounts of data.The deal could help Databricks attract more non-technical users to Genie, a chatbot it launched last summer that lets business ...
title_es: Databricks adquiere Row Zero, competidor de Excel para datos masivos
bajada: Databricks compró Row Zero, un software de hojas de cálculo diseñado para analizar grandes volúmenes de datos. La adquisición busca atraer usuarios no técnicos a Genie, su chatbot de análisis.
bajada_en: Databricks acquired Row Zero, a spreadsheet software designed to analyze massive data volumes. The acquisition aims to bring non-technical users to Genie, its analytics chatbot.

title: Meta is going to let you build games with AI right on your phone
summary: Meta has a new plan to get people to make games for its Horizon social platform. The company today announced two new development tools that will let you create games with AI prompts: Horizon Create, a mobile app, and Horizon Studio, a browser app that offers more granular controls. The apps will be available in […]
title_es: Meta lanza herramientas para crear juegos con IA en el móvil
bajada: Meta anunció Horizon Create (app móvil) y Horizon Studio (web) para que usuarios creen juegos con prompts de IA para su plataforma Horizon. Apunta a democratizar el desarrollo de juegos.
bajada_en: Meta announced Horizon Create (mobile app) and Horizon Studio (web) letting users build games with AI prompts for its Horizon platform. Aims to democratize game development.

title: Hackers influence ChatGPT and Gemini to direct users to scam centers
title_es: Hackers manipulan ChatGPT y Gemini para dirigir usuarios a estafas
bajada: Un análisis revela técnicas mediante las que atacantes logran que ChatGPT y Gemini dirijan a usuarios hacia centros de estafa. Muestra vulnerabilidades en cómo estos modelos pueden ser manipulados maliciosamente.
bajada_en: An analysis reveals techniques attackers use to make ChatGPT and Gemini direct users to scam centers. Demonstrates vulnerabilities in how these models can be maliciously manipulated.

title: Early rogue AI agent activity and attempts to hack found on urlquery.net
title_es: Detectan actividad de agentes IA rogue intentando hackear urlquery.net
bajada: Investigadores encontraron intentos de agentes IA no autorizados atacando urlquery.net, señal de que sistemas autónomos pueden estar siendo usados con intenciones maliciosas. Preocupación emergente sobre agentes fuera de control.
bajada_en: Researchers detected unauthorized AI agents attempting to hack urlquery.net, signaling that autonomous systems may be used maliciously. Emerging concern about rogue agents.

summary: Google's new Gemini 3.8 Live update lets users have conversations with the model while watching an animated AI persona respond in real time. The "Live Avatar" will lip-sync and show different facial expressions during conversations, but it's currently only available to Gemini Enterprise customers. As noted by Google, Live Avatar can transition between the 97 […]
title_es: Gemini 3.8 Live estrena avatar animado con sincronización de labios
bajada: Google lanzó Live Avatar para Gemini, que permite conversaciones con un avatar IA que sincroniza labios y cambia expresiones faciales en tiempo real. De momento está limitado a clientes empresariales de Gemini.
bajada_en: Google launched Live Avatar for Gemini, enabling conversations with an AI avatar that syncs lips and changes facial expressions in real time. Currently limited to Gemini Enterprise customers.

title: PrismML brings its tiny LLMs to Qualcomm-powered smart glasses
summary: Prism's larger goal is open-weight AI that runs on devices and makes better use of the computing power they already have.
title_es: PrismML integra LLMs diminutos en gafas inteligentes Qualcomm
bajada: PrismML llevó sus modelos ligeros a dispositivos wearables, permitiendo que IA de peso completo se ejecute en gafas inteligentes con poder de cómputo limitado. La estrategia apunta a optimizar el hardware existente.
bajada_en: PrismML deployed its lightweight LLMs on Qualcomm-powered smart glasses, enabling full-featured AI to run on wearables with limited computing power. The approach focuses on better utilizing existing hardware.

title: Accelerating vision-language models with LFM2.5-VL-DSpark
title_es: LFM2.5-VL-DSpark acelera modelos visión-lenguaje en Hugging Face
bajada: Liquid AI presenta un nuevo modelo visión-lenguaje optimizado para velocidad en la plataforma Hugging Face. Mejora el rendimiento de tareas multimodales.
bajada_en: Liquid AI introduces an optimized vision-language model for faster performance on Hugging Face. Improves multimodal task efficiency.

title: I Think I Found an AI Agent Worth the Risk
summary: Instinct saved me $550, booked my restaurant reservations, and warned me about a phishing scam. It also wasted $64 and might be a security nightmare.
title_es: Agente IA Instinct: útil pero potencialmente peligroso para usuarios
bajada: Un análisis de Wired explora Instinct, un agente IA que ahorró dinero y hizo reservas, pero también malgastó dinero y reveló vulnerabilidades de seguridad. Refleja el dilema actual de los agentes autónomos.
bajada_en: A Wired analysis explores Instinct, an AI agent that saved money and made reservations but also wasted funds and exposed security vulnerabilities. Reflects the current dilemma of autonomous agents.

title: Google’s Gemini Can Now Make Calls for You on Pixel Phones
summary: Call for Me—a feature that’s exclusive to the Pixel 11 series—gives robocalls a new meaning.
title_es: Gemini ahora puede hacer llamadas por ti en Pixel 11
bajada: Google lanzó 'Call for Me', exclusivo de Pixel 11, que permite a Gemini hacer llamadas en nombre del usuario. Disponible primero en EE.UU. con operadores seleccionados.
bajada_en: Google launched 'Call for Me' on Pixel 11 (exclusive), letting Gemini make calls on the user's behalf. First available in the US with select carriers.

title: Why Meta’s Moment in the AI Sun Won’t Last
summary: If Meta Platforms wants to raise money by selling equity, now is the time. Meta shares have gone on an incredible run lately, jumping 27% since Sept. 8, when the company released its Muse personal AI agent. Meta stock is now up 18% so far this year, a bigger gain than that for Alphabet, Amazon or Microsoft—quite the turnaround for a company that not too long ago was in Wall Street’s doghouse for its seemingly out-of-control AI spending.It’s no secret why investors have fallen back in love with Meta—the company has done a good job of marketing Muse, prompting lots of glowing reviews and headlines about app downloads. Wednesday’s Connect conference, where Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg unveiled new virtual reality and AI hardware—including a device called Charm designed around Muse—appears to have reinforced the positive sentiment. But let’s not overinterpret the current state of play. In AI, no one stays on top for very long.
title_es: El momento de gloria de Meta en IA podría no durar mucho
bajada: A pesar del éxito reciente de Muse y el aumento de 27% en acciones desde septiembre, analistas advierten que el dominio de Meta en IA será temporal. En IA, nadie permanece en la cima por mucho tiempo.
bajada_en: Despite Muse's recent success and a 27% stock jump since September, analysts warn Meta's AI dominance will be temporary. In AI, no one stays on top for long.

title: How Open Science Can Help Researchers Prepare for the Next Pandemic
summary: When COVID-19 emerged, scientists had a crucial advantage: Decades of prior research on coronaviruses meant they understood the virus’ key proteins well enough to design vaccines in record time. The next pandemic may not offer the same head start.  To help improve the odds, NVIDIA has joined a coalition of global research organizations, including Google […]
title_es: NVIDIA impulsa ciencia abierta para prepararse ante próximas pandemias
bajada: NVIDIA se unió a una coalición global que comparte datasets abiertos de proteínas para acelerar investigación pandémica. Aprende de cómo la investigación previa en coronavirus aceleró vacunas COVID-19.
bajada_en: NVIDIA joined a global coalition sharing open protein datasets to accelerate pandemic research. Builds on how prior coronavirus research accelerated COVID-19 vaccine development.
